**C.** Unlawful homicide committed abroad by a minister is not a legitimate exercise of sovereign authority, so it is treated as a private act (jure gestionis) and doesn't attract immunity. My earlier answer of A was wrong. I chose C partly because the team note narrowed the answer to C or B, and C is the option that answers the jure imperii/jure gestionis question directly.

CONFIDENCE: 62
